title: Some Like It Hot
tagline: Two girls in the band. Three courses on the train.
about: Two musicians on the run from the mob disguise themselves as women in an all-girl band.
cue: Serve the drinks when the girls throw a party in Daphne's sleeper berth on the train.
faces: We joined an all-girl band to dodge gangsters. Osgood's asked me to his yacht for champagne, and Joe wants it more.

    StartersSpeakeasy devilled eggs with crispy pancettaDevilled eggs with a Dijon mayo yolk, crispy pancetta, smoked paprikaHow to make it8 eggs80g mayonnaise2 tsp Dijon mustard1 tsp white vinegar1 tsp smoked paprika8 slices of pancetta1 bunch chivesBoil the eggs hard, cool in iced water, peel and halve.Mash the yolks with the mayonnaise, mustard, vinegar and a pinch of paprika until smooth. Pipe back into the whites.Bake the pancetta on a tray at 200°C until crisp, cool and break into shards.Top each egg with pancetta, a dusting of paprika and snipped chives.Florida beach prawnsPrawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, served on iceHow to make it500g green prawns, raw and shell on2 lemons4 tbsp mayonnaise2 tbsp tomato saucehot sauce, to taste2 tbsp salt, for the water4 cups iceBring a pot of water to the boil with the salt and lemon slices.Poach the prawns until pink, then plunge into iced water.Peel the prawns.Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and hot sauce. Serve the prawns on ice with the sauce.Upper berth pimento cheese crackersThe midnight party in Daphne's upper berthHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sharp cheddar beaten with roasted capsicum, mayo and cayenne into a spread, piled on crackers with thin salami and a slice of cornichon.Grate 250g vintage cheddar.Finely chop 100g drained roasted red capsicum.Mix the cheese and capsicum with 100g mayonnaise, 50g soft cream cheese, a pinch of cayenne and a few drops of hot sauce until spreadable.Chill 30 minutes.Spread generously on 32 water crackers, top each with a fold of salami (100g total) and a slice of cornichon, and stack them on a tray.Clams casinoNobody's perfect. Steam the green beans.Grill the lobster until just cooked.Toss the potatoes and beans with butter and serve with lemon wedges.Friends of Italian Opera meatball spaghettiThe gangsters' banquet for the Friends of Italian OperaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan and parsley, browned and simmered in a rich tomato and basil sugo, piled over spaghetti on one big platter.Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 50g breadcrumbs soaked in 60ml milk, 1 egg, 40g grated parmesan, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 garlic clove and salt.Roll into 20 balls and brown in olive oil.Remove.Soften 1 onion and 2 garlic cloves, add 1.4kg passata and simmer 10 minutes.Return the meatballs, cover and simmer 30 minutes, adding basil at the end.Cook 500g spaghetti, toss with some sauce and pile onto a platter with the meatballs and more parmesan.SweetsBig birthday cakeThree butter sponge layers with strawberry jam and whipped creamHow to make it300g butter, softened300g caster sugar5 eggs300g self-raising flour200g strawberry jam600ml thickened cream250g icing sugar1 tbsp milk12 candlesBeat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour.
